title: SiliconExpert Part Search Spec
description: Request body for a parametric part search against the SiliconExpert ProductAPI (https://app.siliconexpert.com/ProductAPI/). Generated by the Istari Part Search Agent.

category.description: SiliconExpert taxonomy category name (exact string, case-sensitive). Must be a valid SE taxonomy leaf node.

keyword.description: Free-text keyword search string. Used to narrow results by description, part type, or key spec values (e.g. 'metal film 4.7k 0402').

manufacturer.description: Filter results to a specific manufacturer. Use the manufacturer's common display name as known to SiliconExpert (e.g. 'Vishay', 'Murata', 'Texas Instruments', 'Yageo', 'Panasonic').

filters.description: Parametric attribute filters. Each entry is a {name, value} pair using SiliconExpert attribute names exactly as they appear in the SE taxonomy for the chosen category. All values must be strings.

name.description: SiliconExpert attribute name (title-case with spaces). Valid names include: 'Resistance', 'Capacitance', 'Inductance', 'Tolerance', 'Voltage Rating', 'Current Rating', 'Power Rating', 'Case/Package', 'Temperature Coefficient', 'Dielectric', 'Mounting Style', 'Frequency', 'Forward Voltage', 'Output Current', 'Supply Voltage Min', 'Supply Voltage Max', 'Number of Pins', 'Operating Temperature Min', 'Operating Temperature Max'.

value.description: Attribute value as a string. Include units where applicable (e.g. '4.7 kOhm', '100 nF', '50 V', '0.25 W', '1%', '0402', 'SMD/SMT').

lifecycle.description: Restrict results to parts with one or more of these SiliconExpert lifecycle statuses. Omit to return all statuses. Recommend ['Active'] for new designs.

rohsCompliant.description: If true, restrict results to RoHS-compliant parts only. Recommended true for most electronics programs.

reachCompliant.description: If true, restrict results to REACH-compliant parts only.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of results per page (1–100). Default 10.

fields.description: Response field groups to include. Omit to receive all available fields.
